dependency_semantics: Required accepted predecessor outputs; see each rationale.toml. This planning index is not a new core schema or an execution scheduler.

warrants.title: Adopt the exact RC.2 build basis without rewriting history
warrants.seam: Candidate source-set review and the existing SAS acceptance boundary
warrants.outcome: The owner can review and adopt the exact RC.2 source set and its migration decisions; subsequent work has an explicit governing basis.

warrants.title: Parse and validate a minimal OpenWarrant document
warrants.outcome: A caller can parse a minimal document, retain exact source units, and distinguish document validity from readiness.

warrants.title: Author valid documents from explicit fields
warrants.seam: author_document followed by the public parser and validator
warrants.outcome: Manual or agent callers can supply fields and obtain one readable, deterministic document without a model or interactive UI.

warrants.title: Capture immutable sources and resolve exact references
warrants.seam: capture_sources and resolve_refs with an explicit filesystem shell
warrants.outcome: A caller obtains one immutable source lock and unambiguous references to exact document units and opaque evidence bytes.

warrants.title: Evaluate context conditions with explicit uncertainty
warrants.seam: evaluate_condition over declared stage, subsystem and path inputs
warrants.outcome: A caller receives TRUE, FALSE or UNKNOWN with reasons under one documented, filesystem-independent condition grammar.

warrants.title: Select complete context and expose conflicts
warrants.seam: select_units over the captured source graph
warrants.outcome: A caller receives the complete applicable rule set, including definitions and exceptions, with all inclusion reasons and explicit blockers.

warrants.title: Build master context and faithful role projections
warrants.seam: assemble_master, project_role and render_entry over one versioned IR
warrants.outcome: Preparation, performer, verifier and human reviewers receive role-specific views with the same exact governing basis and required constraints.

warrants.title: Export and verify portable offline context packages
warrants.seam: build_package and check_package in an offline consumer
warrants.outcome: An agent can obtain every required context byte from a portable package, and a consumer can verify integrity and declared semantic coverage without the original repository.

warrants.title: Enforce context budgets and invalidate stale cache entries
warrants.seam: account_entry and basis_key after in-memory rendering and before publication
warrants.outcome: A caller sees truthful final-entry size estimates and a cache identity that changes whenever relevant source, policy, role or compiler inputs change.

warrants.title: Check supplied readiness and assurance records truthfully
warrants.seam: check_records, evaluate_readiness and evaluate_assurance over supplied facts
warrants.outcome: A caller receives separate document validity, readiness and assurance eligibility results tied to exact revisions; the library does not perform real-world approvals or issue marks.

warrants.title: Import legacy history without changing what was signed
warrants.seam: import_legacy and successor-history validation over retained legacy fixtures
warrants.outcome: A caller can use mapped legacy material and successor revisions while retaining original bytes, identities, digest domains and honest unsupported facts.

warrants.title: Prove every Phase 1 primitive through a runnable driver
warrants.seam: rc2_probe --all plus public-boundary integration tests and the repository aggregate gate
warrants.outcome: Every scoped library feature can be invoked directly and reproduced from fixtures before production CLI integration begins.

warrants.title: Expose the complete compiler through a machine-safe CLI
warrants.seam: war context capture/master/project/export/check over the same typed library request model
warrants.outcome: External callers can capture sources, build a master, project a role, export a packet and check it through a supported CLI without prompts, models or a running service.

warrants.title: Expose noninteractive document authoring and validation
warrants.seam: war document new/edit/check using explicit fields and one typed request model
warrants.outcome: Humans, scripts and skills can create or edit one document through explicit CLI fields and check it without interactive prompts.

warrants.title: Make document authoring interactive and recoverable
warrants.seam: Interactive field selection and editing through the document CLI under a pseudo-terminal
warrants.outcome: A developer selects a field, writes it, sees validation and saves a complete document; cancellation preserves their previous draft.

warrants.title: Prepare installable compiler release artifacts and user docs
warrants.seam: Fresh installation and documented compiler commands on Linux and macOS
warrants.outcome: A new consumer can install the candidate compiler and follow the documentation to create, compile and inspect a portable package on each supported platform.

warrants.title: Qualify the integrated compiler and freeze the Stable source set
warrants.seam: Integrated CLI/compiler conformance, deterministic context tasks and exact release-candidate artifacts
warrants.outcome: The owner receives a complete, independently reviewed Stable acceptance package that binds the actual compiler build, standard edition and observed release evidence.

warrants.title: Publish and verify OpenWarrant Stable 1.0
warrants.seam: Public release ref, downloadable artifacts and registry consumers at one approved Stable revision
warrants.outcome: Stable 1.0 standard and compiler are publicly available, correctly labeled and usable from fresh installations; only then is the agreed chat completion signal sent.
